As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. Familiarity with backup, replication, and disaster recovery product design.
Familiarity with cloud storage economics and tiering strategy across hot, warm, and cold tiers.
Experience managing or mentoring other product managers.

ashby:loancrate:4b269fea-6ef2-4fcb-8792-.summary:
We started Loancrate to make home-buying simpler and less expensive for lenders and borrowers. Today, mortgage lenders are stuck running their companies on software products built 20 years ago. These products are slow, unstable, and don't lead to material improvements in efficiency. When using these systems, the average human cost to originate a loan is still over $11,000.

Loancrate builds AI-native tooling to automate mortgage workflows. Our ultimate goal is fully automated origination, which has the potential to save lenders over $16B in operating expense per year.

Since starting in 2020, our remote team has enabled our customers to power >$85 billion in new home loans. We care about collaboration, very open communication covering the good & the bad so that we learn from our decisions quickly, and ultimately having fun while we're building. You'll fit in well if you like diving deep…

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: Mortgage lenders don't switch loan origination systems lightly. An LOS transition touches every workflow a lender has - origination, processing, underwriting, closing - and it has to happen without slowing down the pipeline or losing a single file in the shuffle. We're looking for an Implementation Lead to own that transition from the project-management side: building the rollout plan, keeping every team on track to hit it, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between sales, our Implementation Consultants, our Customer Success Managers, and the customer.

You'll own the full project plan for each customer implementation - milestones, timelines, who's doing what by when - while our CSMs and Implementation Consultants own the mortgage-advisory and hands-on configuration work with the customer. Your job is to be the person who can look at any implementation on any given day and say exactly where it stands, what's blocking it, and what has to happen next to hit go-live.

Because you’ll be running implementations for a mortgage lending product, you need firsthand experience leading a lender through an LOS transition. You’ve owned the project plan, coordinated the teams and dependencies, and helped take a lender through go-live. We can teach you Loancrate, our tooling, and our approach, but we’re looking for someone who already understands what it takes to keep an LOS transition moving.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own all project management for customer implementations - you're the single point of accountability for the plan, the timeline, and whether an implementation is on track.

Define rollout milestones and keep every team organized around them - sales handoff, configuration, data migration, UAT, training, go-live - and make sure the Implementation Consultants, CSMs, and the customer's own team are aligned on what's due when.

Keep Jira and Linear in sync and own regular project updates - maintain accurate statuses, owners, and next steps so customers and internal teams have a clear view of progress without having to chase for information.

Own the coordination and follow-through for implementation meetings - prepare and distribute agendas, facilitate status discussions, capture decisions and action items, and follow up with owners so next steps keep moving.
Build a repeatable rollout plan - turn what you learn from each implementation into a playbook and template the next one can start from, instead of rebuilding the plan from scratch every time.
Flag risks and dependencies early - identify when a milestone is at risk, bring the right people together to resolve blockers, and escalate decisions with clear context and timeline impacts.

Partner closely with CSMs and Implementation Consultants - you own the plan, they own the mortgage-advisory and configuration conversations with the customer; your job is to keep their work sequenced and on schedule.
Be the internal voice for process - as we run more implementations in parallel, help Product and Engineering understand where timelines are getting stretched by product gaps versus process gaps.

sections.title: What Success Looks Like
paras: By the 12-18 month mark, you'll have run multiple lender implementations end-to-end, refined the rollout methodology into something the next hire can pick up with minimal ramp, and be a candidate to help build and lead a broader Implementation/PMO function as we scale.
bullets: Be running the project plan for at least one active customer implementation, with milestones defined and Jira/Linear set up to keep the customer automatically informed.
Have a clear, repeatable rollout plan template that the next implementation can be built from.
Have run implementation meetings end-to-end - agenda, discussion, and clear next steps - without needing someone else to drive them.
Have a direct working relationship with the Implementation Consultants and CSMs on your implementations, with a clear, mutually understood division of who owns what.

sections.title: Required Skills and Background
bullets: Direct mortgage industry experience - you've worked in mortgage, ideally at a lender or mortgage tech company, and understand the origination-to-closing lifecycle well enough to build a realistic project plan around it.

Hands-on experience with an LOS transition - you've personally been part of migrating a lender from one loan origination system to another (Encompass, Empower, Byte, or similar) and know firsthand what makes that kind of project succeed or stall.

Strong PMO / program management background - you've run structured, multi-workstream projects with real deadlines and multiple stakeholders, and you default to clear milestones, owners, and status tracking rather than ad hoc coordination.
Fluency with Jira and/or Linear - you can set up and maintain project tracking that stays accurate without constant manual upkeep, including external-facing visibility for customers.

Strong meeting facilitation and written communication - you can run a room, keep a steering committee on track, and write status updates that executives and customers can act on without follow-up questions.
Process-builder mindset - you're drawn to turning one-off project work into a repeatable system, and you document as you go rather than carrying the plan only in your head.
Bias to action and comfort with ambiguity - we're building this function from the ground up; you'll be designing the process, not inheriting one.

Collaborative, low-ego operating style - you'll be coordinating closely with CSMs, Implementation Consultants, Engineering, and the customer, and you know how to keep people aligned without owning every piece of the work yourself.

bullets: A technical builder: You want to configure, integrate, test and troubleshoot—not merely coordinate the people doing that work.

Evidence-driven: You use logs, payloads, configuration records, database results and test evidence to establish what is happening.
Pragmatic about implementation design: You prefer a supported standard pattern over an elegant one-off solution that no one can maintain.
Customer-facing: You can work directly with a client’s engineers, operators and business stakeholders without losing technical precision.
Accountable through production: You do not declare success when configuration is complete; you remain responsible through validation, launch and stabilization.
Clear about product boundaries: You solve implementation problems inside implementation and escalate only genuine product defects or capability gaps.
Comfortable with ambiguity: You can turn incomplete requirements into concrete technical questions, assumptions and validation steps.

Product fixes for security findings. When a researcher reports an issue through our bug bounty program, design the product change that fixes it. For example, we reworked account invitations so invited users have to explicitly accept.

paras: Amtech provides enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems support order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics, helping customers improve efficiency and operational performance.

sections.title: ABOUT THE ROLE
paras: As an Implementation Consultant on Amtech’s Professional Services team, you will help packaging, printing, and manufacturing customers implement and use Amtech software. You will guide customers through requirements gathering, software configuration, testing, training, and go-live support, including workflows that connect daily operations with accounting and financial reporting.

We welcome experience in ERP implementation or support, business analysis, manufacturing operations, purchasing, accounting, finance, and software consulting. Experience as an ERP superuser, supporting system improvements, or training users can provide a strong foundation for this role.

You will bring an understanding of business processes, working knowledge of how operational activities connect to accounting within an ERP system, strong customer communication, and practical problem-solving skills. You will develop expertise in Amtech’s products and implementation approach as you learn the role. An accounting degree is not required.

sections.title: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
bullets: Support and execute customer implementation activities, including requirements gathering, software configuration, process documentation, testing, and end-user training.
Work with customer operations, purchasing, accounting, and finance teams to understand business processes and translate requirements into practical configurations within Amtech’s products.
Help customers configure and adopt workflows supporting order management, purchasing, inventory, invoicing, costing, and financial reporting, based on assigned project scope.
Facilitate customer workshops, document current and future workflows, and explain system processes to users with different levels of ERP experience.
Support data preparation, testing, and validation. Investigate discrepancies and collaborate with customer subject matter experts and internal teams to resolve issues.
Deliver virtual and onsite training, support customers during go-live and stabilization, and develop reusable training materials and process documentation.
Identify delivery risks and scope gaps, communicate issues early, and keep assigned activities aligned with the approved statement of work, project milestones, and quality standards.
Maintain accurate project documentation, time and travel records, and handoff information.

sections.title: REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Understanding of business workflows and working knowledge of how processes such as invoicing, purchasing, inventory, or costing connect to accounting and financial reporting within an ERP system.
Experience helping users adopt or improve business systems through requirements gathering, workflow analysis, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, reporting, or training.

Strong organizational, problem-solving, documentation, and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage priorities across concurrent projects.
Ability to work independently, collaborate with project teams, and communicate effectively with stakeholders from end users to executive leadership.
Proficiency with Excel or comparable spreadsheet tools for reviewing data, identifying discrepancies, and supporting reporting.
Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

greenhouse:axios:7963917.summary:
The big picture: Axios is a media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment.

Axios is hiring an SVP, Product to lead how Axios builds products across the company, strengthening Product and Design while turning promising AI-enabled ideas into durable, supported products.

Why it matters: Axios builds and ships at multiple levels. Product and Design lead the development of durable, company-wide products and shared platforms. AI Enablement partners with departments to identify opportunities, prototype AI-enabled tools and workflows, and help teams put useful solutions into practice.

sections.title: What you’ll do:
paras: Go deeper: This leader must be a trusted partner to senior leaders, with a clear point of view on where technology is moving, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the judgment to turn ambiguity into decisions.

Success means a clear company-wide model for deciding what Axios should build and why, stronger and faster Product and Design decisions, and a repeatable path from promising AI experiments to durable, supported products.
bullets: Lead Product, Design, and AI Enablement, setting strategy, priorities, decision rights, and operating cadence.
Look ahead: turn a clear point of view on emerging technologies, behaviors, and opportunities into credible product choices and experiments.
Partner with business leaders to translate company and functional goals into clear product opportunities, outcomes, and investment choices.
Raise the product management bar through clear expectations, coaching, and accountability.
Create a clear path from promising experiments to durable, supported products.

sections.title: What we’re looking for:
paras:
Worth your time: This is an opportunity to help define what modern product leadership looks like inside an AI-native media company. You’ll help shape not only what Axios builds, but how Axios operates.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $285,000 - $315,000, plus a 25% bonus, and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation and benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.
What Axios brings to the table besides salary:
bullets: A trusted partner to senior leaders who can challenge assumptions, form a clear point of view, make hard tradeoffs, and keep decisions moving.
A clear vision for where product development is headed and how Axios can succeed as the technology landscape rapidly evolves.
Demonstrated AI fluency: you personally use AI to accelerate your work and prototype ideas, and you know how to turn AI capabilities into useful products and workflows.
Senior product leadership experience in software, information services, media, or another fast-moving environment, with a record of bringing Product and Design together.
Technical fluency across product strategy, workflows, tooling, data, and production tradeoffs.
Experience with prioritization and portfolio management across multiple stakeholders.
A track record of turning prototypes and experiments into durable, supported products.
The judgment to create useful governance without becoming a bottleneck.

sections.title: OVERVIEW
paras: As an Account Manager- Sports Sponsorships at BDA, you will play a vital role in building and maintaining strong relationships with our clients. The role of Account Manager at BDA is dynamic and customer focused. Success in this position requires a combination of sales acumen, relationship building, creativity, project management, product knowledge, and the ability to consistently deliver excellent service to clients. greenhouse:braze:8164560.summary:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

sections.title: ABOUT BRAZE
paras: Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.
The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

sections.title: OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS
paras: At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.
Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:
bullets: To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.

To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a retroactive manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com .

greenhouse:brex:8762350002.summary: Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

sections.title: Sales at Brex
paras: Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.

sections.title: What you’ll do
paras: As an Account Manager II, you'll strategically own a book of our higher-value, more complex customers and carry the number for net revenue retention and expansion across it. You'll operate as a commercial advisor rather than a support contact: multi-threading into economic buyers and finance executives, leading complex multi-product negotiations, and structuring deals that hold up over multiple years.

Roughly 70% of your time goes to commercial execution and growth, and the other 30% to driving the product adoption that makes expansion durable. You'll also be a force multiplier on the team, mentoring earlier-career AMs and helping set the standard for how the account management motion runs at Brex.

sections.title: Where you’ll work
paras: This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Strategically own a book of higher-value, more complex accounts, typically 100 to 130 accounts, and drive net revenue retention and expansion across it
Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for your customers, ensuring Brex is an essential part of how they operate
Act as a commercial advisor: multi-thread into economic buyers and executive stakeholders, from Controller up to CFO, tailoring your communication and value framing to each audience

Drive revenue by proactively identifying expansion opportunities and tying Brex's value to measurable business results, including running structured discovery, building business cases, and creating commercial proposals

Lead complex, multi-product negotiations and structure deals across pricing, terms, and multi-year commitments, partnering with Risk, Underwriting, Legal, and Deal Desk to balance customer needs with revenue impact
Own large expansion and cross-sell motions in partnership with Sales and Solutions Engineering
Turn churn-risk accounts around, handling objections and competitive pressure with ease, and flag risks early with a recommended plan of action
Build and deliver quarterly business reviews that tie product value to commercial outcomes, ROI, and expansion

greenhouse:buildkite:5485995008.summary: Buildkite's CI platform is trusted by the world's leading engineering teams, helping ship software used by more than 1 billion people every day. Companies including Canva, Meta, Mistral AI, and NVIDIA rely on Buildkite to run builds, tests, and deployments on their infrastructure, ours, or both - giving them the speed, reliability, and flexibility to ship with confidence.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: As a Senior CSM at Buildkite, you'll be a senior individual contributor responsible for driving measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of Buildkite’s Enterprise customers. You are the customer’s strategic partner in value realization - accountable for the adoption of Buildkite, the outcomes the customer achieves with it and the long-term health of the partnership.

You’ll co-own each account with an Account Executive. The AE drives the growth of the partnership and owns the commercial relationship. You own the value the customer gets from what they’ve already purchased. You’ll work alongside a Technical Account Manager, who leads technical advisory on the customer’s current solutions, while the AE partners with a Solutions Architect on what the customer is evaluating next. You and the AE both build relationships at every level of the customer’s organization, each at your own angle.

You’ll join a small, senior team while Buildkite’s Customer Success function is maturing quickly and you’ll help shape the playbooks and operating model that come next. We are looking for someone who wants to improve the role, not just fill it.

sections.title: Strategic Account Leadership
bullets: Post-Sale Ownership: Own the post-sale state of your named Enterprise accounts: health, adoption, retention and spotting expansion opportunities. You do this in partnership with your Account Executive, who owns the commercial side of the relationship.
Value Realization: Drive measurable business outcomes from the Buildkite investment by aligning each account’s success plan to the customer’s core engineering and business goals.

Account Team Partnership: Work as one account team with your AE, TAM and Solutions Architect. Bring in Product, Support and Engineering when the account needs them, so the customer experiences one cohesive Buildkite.
Cadence Design: Determine when and how to engage each account based on the value it returns to the customer — right-sizing engagement so every interaction earns its place on the customer’s calendar.
Operating Model Contribution: Help shape the playbooks, processes, and operating model of a maturing CS function — and mentor new team members as the team grows.

sections.title: Executive Influence and Customer Partnership
bullets: Executive Engagement: Cultivate and maintain trusted relationships with customer C-suite, VP, Director, and program-owner stakeholders — including the executive sponsor accountable for the Buildkite investment.
Business Translation: Translate technical adoption and platform health into the business outcomes that matter to executive sponsors, and into the language they use with their own leadership.
Executive Business Reviews: Lead the EBR cadence with the AE and TAM — bringing the value narrative, customer readiness, and forward-looking strategy that keeps the partnership on track.
Customer Advocacy: Amplify the voice of the customer inside Buildkite, ensuring Product, Engineering, and Support stay focused on what matters most to the accounts you own.

sections.title: Risk, Renewal, and Expansion Readiness
bullets: Account Health: Maintain a live view of technical, commercial, support, and relationship signals across your portfolio — surface risk early, mobilize the right Buildkite resources, and prevent escalation through proactive partnership.
Renewal Strategy: Partner with the Account Executive on renewal strategy by driving the value narrative, customer readiness, and account health that underpin every commercial conversation.
Expansion Sourcing: Identify and source expansion opportunities through the Customer-Sourced Qualified Lead (CSQL) process — turning customer outcomes into growth.
Onboarding: Partner with the Technical Account Manager on the first 90 days, and sustain the joint CSM/TAM cadence that drives customers from go-live to long-term value.

Direct experience with or proximity to AI researchers: how they think, what they evaluate, what earns trust versus eye-rolls.

Couchbase, the operational data platform for AI, empowers businesses to succeed by bringing data to life in new ways. Major market-leading companies rely on Couchbase for mission critical operational, analytical, mobile and AI workloads. Built to replace legacy infrastructure and fragmented data services, Couchbase empowers enterprises with a unified platform architected for performance, flexibility and global scale.

With Couchbase, organizations bring their data to life, launching game‑changing customer experiences, exploring the limitless potential of AI, and seamlessly extending applications from the cloud to the edge and beyond. Couchbase’s AI‑ready technology and enterprise partnership model eliminate complexity and reduce total cost of ownership, enabling teams to stay agile, innovative and secure.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Couchbase is hiring a Principal Product Manager to own execution for the Couchbase Mobile portfolio — Couchbase Lite, Sync Gateway / Capella App Services, and Edge Server. This is a mature, widely-adopted portfolio, and this Principal-level role owns the execution rigor — release quality, developer experience, and technical depth of requirements — that keeps it excellent as it grows to support edge and on-device AI use cases.

The portfolio spans a full cloud-to-edge-to-device data layer: Couchbase Lite is the embedded database inside mobile, desktop, and web apps; Sync Gateway and Capella App Services provide self-managed and fully managed sync backends; and Edge Server is our lightweight, resource-constrained edge database for environments. Increasingly, these products also need to support AI-powered applications running at the edge, where data has to stay local, fast, and always available. You'll need a real point of view on how to extend the portfolio, grounded in hands-on technical judgment.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Turn product strategy for the Couchbase Mobile portfolio (Couchbase Lite, Sync Gateway, Capella App Services, Edge Server) into a detailed, well-sequenced roadmap, and drive it through to shipped, adopted product with rigor.

Own end-to-end execution day-to-day: write detailed technical product requirements, partner closely with engineering and design, validate pre-release features hands-on, and contribute to the operational cadence (JIRA, sprint/roadmap reviews, agile ceremonies).

Bring operational excellence to a mature, multi-product portfolio — tighten release quality, close gaps in documentation and developer experience, and systematically remove friction that's built up across established products.
Shape how the portfolio supports on-device and edge AI use cases, and turn that into concrete, engineering-ready requirements that keep the mobile/edge products relevant as AI moves to the edge.
Work directly with customers and prospects to pressure-test use cases and turn them into functional requirements and clear build/don't-build calls.
Be the first line of product ownership on live customer escalations — working directly with field, sales, and support leadership to unblock accounts, and driving fixes through engineering.

Act as the portfolio's lead technical evangelist: represent Couchbase Mobile in talks, webinars, technical content, and arm sales, solutions engineering, and marketing with the training and positioning they need.
Represent the portfolio in cross-org planning with senior leadership — this is leadership through execution excellence and technical depth, not people management.

You’ll start by understanding each customer’s business goals, stakeholders, technology, and workflows, then build a clear, practical plan that keeps every workstream and team member aligned.

You’ll serve as a trusted consultant to customers and partner with a Senior Technical Implementation Manager, who owns the technical components of each implementation. Together, you’ll connect customer needs with the Findigs’ platform, translate requirements into actionable plans, and coordinate with Product, Engineering, and other internal partners. You’ll also help strengthen how implementation works at Findigs by refining our playbook, identifying opportunities to simplify or automate manual work, and making launches more repeatable and scalable.

Keep every workstream on track. Align customer teams, Product, Engineering, and other internal partners to the plan, and hold everyone accountable to dates and decisions.

Lead discovery and scoping. Run discovery on each customer’s business goals, stakeholder landscape, and operating workflows, then translate it into clear scope, documentation, and a phased project plan.

Consult on screening criteria. Help customers translate their goals and inputs into consistent screening criteria, and use Findigs’ data and insights to advise on how criteria can be structured to support optimal decision-making.

Coordinate credentialing. Work closely with the compliance team and customer stakeholders to manage the plan and dependencies across entity verification, business application review, onsite inspection approval, and credentialing with credit and criminal data vendors.
Lead issue resolution and solutioning for complex property-management-system (PMS) integrations and configuration challenges across Yardi, MRI, Appfolio and others.

Contract Title : Project Consultant/ Senior Product Marketing Manager

Duration: Through June 30, 2027

Hours: 40 hours per week

Compensation : $80–90/hour, depending on skills, experience, and location

Location: Bay Area or NYC; PST hours preferred

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy and execution for a consumer AI product at one of the world’s leading technology companies. You’ll shape how new products and features are positioned, introduced and brought to life across consumer channels. Working closely with product, creative, growth and communications teams, you’ll translate emerging AI capabilities into clear, compelling stories that help people understand the product’s value and inspire them to try it. This role requires strong strategic judgment, excellent writing and the ability to move from planning to hands-on execution in a rapidly evolving product environment.

sections.title: Impact
bullets: Own end-to-end go-to-market plans for product and feature launches, including audience and competitive insights, positioning, goals, success metrics, asset development and integrated launch planning.
Tailor marketing support to each launch’s scale and priority, from comprehensive launch campaigns to targeted social, app store and website updates.
Develop differentiated positioning, value propositions and messaging grounded in consumer needs, product capabilities and business objectives.
Partner with privacy and legal teams to communicate clearly and accurately about privacy, data access and how the product works.
Lead cross-functional launch planning across product, design, communications, creators, brand, privacy, growth, paid media, web and insights teams.
Shape content and creative strategy for app store listings and marketing websites, and provide direction to teams amplifying the product across other channels.
Use generative AI tools directly to create and iterate on marketing assets, product demos and prototypes.
Maintain current launch plans, track dependencies and decisions, and drive alignment through shared planning tools and regular go-to-market working sessions

sections.title: What Success Looks Like
bullets: Launches have clear audience priorities, differentiated messaging, measurable goals and coordinated execution.
Consumers can quickly understand what the product does, why it matters and how to use it.
Marketing investment and execution match the opportunity and priority of each launch.
Cross-functional partners stay aligned on decisions, ownership, dependencies and timelines as product plans evolve.
Audience insights and launch performance inform ongoing improvements to messaging, creative and channel strategy.
AI-generated assets and prototypes help teams explore ideas, communicate product value and accelerate execution.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: 8+ years of product marketing experience in consumer technology, ideally with AI-powered products, mobile apps or consumer platforms.
Proven success bringing products to market and driving measurable adoption, engagement or growth.
Strong positioning and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technology into clear, differentiated consumer value.
Excellent writing and creative judgment, including the ability to evaluate messaging and creative for clarity, accuracy and audience relevance.
Strong analytical skills, with experience turning consumer research, competitive intelligence and performance data into actionable recommendations.
Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive decisions in fast-moving, matrixed organizations.
Hands-on proficiency with generative AI tools for content creation, visual assets, demos or prototyping.
Experience with AI product marketing and privacy-sensitive consumer communications preferred.

smartrecruiters:vusiongroupsa:7440001634.summary:
Vusion is seeking an analytical, client-focused Data & AI Solutions Consultant to help retailers turn business challenges into measurable opportunities through data, analytics, and AI. As part of our growing Vusion Intelligence team in North America, you'll work directly with retail customers to understand their needs, translate business requirements into practical solutions, and deliver measurable value.

This role combines solutions consulting, hands-on data analysis, and collaboration with Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams. You'll work with colleagues across North America and Europe to support customer initiatives from discovery through implementation, adoption, and business impact.

sections.title: We build. We create impact.
paras: You will make a positive impact by being responsible for:
bullets: Engaging retail customers to understand business objectives, operational challenges, and opportunities across merchandising, pricing, inventory, and store operations.
Leading discovery discussions, gathering requirements, and translating business needs into actionable use cases and functional specifications.
Identifying data and AI solution opportunities and collaborating with Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to assess feasibility and recommend solutions.
Analyzing retail datasets and interpreting findings to validate assumptions, uncover insights, and inform business recommendations.
Defining KPIs, success measures, and business cases to demonstrate customer value and solution effectiveness.
Presenting insights, solution recommendations, and demonstrations to client stakeholders, including nontechnical audiences.
Supporting pilots, testing, validation, implementation, and adoption while coordinating cross-functional deliverables.
Documenting requirements and outcomes, identifying recurring customer needs, and supporting opportunities to expand solution adoption.

sections.title: Experience
bullets: 3–5 years of relevant experience in retail analytics, business consulting, data-driven solutions, retail technology, or a related field.
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, evaluate processes, and translate challenges into actionable recommendations.
Hands-on experience analyzing and interpreting data, with a solid understanding of analytics concepts, data structures, and business intelligence methodologies.

sections.title: Preferred Experience
bullets: Experience in retail, retail technology, consulting, or analytics software, particularly grocery, merchandising, pricing, inventory, or store operations.
Familiarity with retail data sources, including POS transactions, product, promotional, inventory, or loyalty data.
Experience supporting software implementations, pilots, proof-of-concept initiatives, or solution consulting.
Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python; exposure to Azure, Snowflake, or practical AI/ML applications.

sections.title: Skills
bullets: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect data insights to business outcomes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools.
Strong client communication, presentation, and requirements-gathering skills, including explaining technical concepts to nontechnical audiences.
Effective organization, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
